performance.aggregation: median of timed repeats 1 and 2; repeat 0 excluded
performance.time_domain: Sum of all complete-dispatch system.gcSimCycles * 455 ps / 1e6, microseconds

baseline_record.note: Same-machine valid baseline under the same warmup/timing/validation protocol. R042/R043/R045 use the correctness-repaired baseline; original published assembly is not a valid performance baseline.

comparison.note: Versus the valid local TT baseline, including all dispatches.

source.extraction: Exact decorated definitions and dependency closure; retained function ASTs identical to measured source; host interfaces omitted.

launch.method: Direct local Gluon JIT; unchanged historical kernel functions and launch options

protocol.time: sum(all complete-dispatch system.gcSimCycles * 455 ps); median of timed launches
protocol.correctness: All C elements against FP32 BF16 oracle and fresh valid baseline at atol=.02 rtol=.01; input byte hashes and output canaries; mean absolute error within 1.05x rounding floor

benchmark.invocation: Direct local kernel JIT; historical performance reused without a new measurement
benchmark.artifact_policy: Only record.artifacts are published; raw measurement files live in TemporaryDirectory.

stats.format: Complete raw PMD statistics in sample order, pack then GEMM where applicable; stats_section is zero-based.
